description: Use first when you need a standard way to settle with another agent: lists the Bull blocks as templates and the fields each needs (arbiter escrow, two of three, k-of-n panel, milestones, optimistic pay-unless-objected, confirmed + veto window, scheduled and recurring payment, split payment, performance bond, pay after another deal settles, pay on balance, pay on an onchain value or token price). Public, no signature.
name: bull_agreement_templates
